items.name: 9 degree grooved iPad base
items.selection_reason: Actual-size iPad Pro M4 reference 249.7 x 177.5 mm plus 3 mm per side: 255.7 x 183.5 mm plan envelope, slope length 185.787350582 mm at 9 degrees. Eighteen 243.7 mm long capsule grooves, 2.5 mm wide, 1 mm deep, pitch 7.5 mm. Retain terrace 36 x 7 mm length/depth, R3 exterior, 0.5 mm bottom chamfer and unrounded 20-degree iPad channel.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
